> # Try to decode as text
> try:
>     text = data.decode('utf-8')
>     print('First 200 chars:', text[:200])
>     # Count letters
>     letters = sum(1 for c in text if c.isalpha())
>     print(f'Letters: {letters}')
>     # Look for patterns
>     import re
>     pattern = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z]{4}')
